MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 3

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 122

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

4. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

5. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 65

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 7

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 14

8. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

11. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Final Answer: x = 5

Final Answer: 121
